name: Underpass
author: E. T. Carter
description: A wet night road runs under a long concrete viaduct, its portal frames and piers receding into blue-black fog under pairs of wine-pink lamps wrapped in halos and rings. The lamps streak down the glossy asphalt in long broken reflections as the camera drifts forward, fog banks roll across, and from time to time a pair of headlights surfaces out of the haze, washing the piers, deck and road before dissolving.

params.label: Drive
params.effect: Speed of the slow forward drift along the road, carrying the frames, lamps and lane paint toward the viewer.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: Fog density: thin fog shows many frames and tight halos, thick fog swallows the depth and swells the halos.

params.label: Lamp glow
params.effect: Brightness of the lamps, their halos and rings, and the passing headlights.

params.label: Wetness
params.effect: How long and bright the reflection streaks stretch down the road and how glossy the asphalt sheen is.
